name: animated-tabs
title: Tabs
description: Animated tabs with a moving active indicator and panel transitions

changelog.summary: Changed the defaultActiveIndex remixer control from a slider to a dropdown so tabs are picked by name instead of a raw index.
Removed the tabs content prop from the public/remixer API and wired accentColor and duration into the active indicator and panel transitions.

Added defaultActiveIndex, animationType, and slideDistance as public props with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested props (defaultTab, accentColor, duration, orientation) didn't match this component's real API (tab content is JSX, not JSON-editable, and there's no accentColor/orientation concept), so they were replaced with the props AnimatedTabsComp actually accepts.
Under reduced motion, use opacity fade instead of horizontal slide

props.name: defaultActiveIndex
props.description: Index of the initially active tab.

props.name: slideDistance
props.description: Horizontal travel distance for the slide transition, in pixels.

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Color used for the active tab label and indicator.

props.name: duration
props.description: Panel and indicator transition duration in seconds.
